verdict.rationale: Radar surfaces data-derived insights inside the Dashboard. Fraud Insights identifies combinations of Radar attributes that affect fraud rates, and Risk Insights explains the risk factors behind Radar's scoring of a payment. Neither is documented as AI-generated insight or as actionable suggestions, so this is only partial. missing for 10: explicit AI/LLM-generated insights or natural-language summaries, proactive suggestions (e.g. recommended rules), any in-product AI assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Identify combinations of Radar attributes that impact your fraud rates.
Risk insights shows you the risk factors that power Stripe Radar.
